## `artifact-versions.observe`

Hashes a workspace file and records a referenced or snapshotted version.

- Version: `1.0.0`
- Audiences: ui, agent, system
- Effect: `workspace-write`
- Approval: none

## `artifact-versions.read`

Reads integrity-checked bytes for one pinned artifact version.

- Version: `1.0.0`
- Audiences: ui, agent, system
- Effect: `read`
- Approval: none
- Scope: workspace

Creates the canonical Playwright page for a visible SciForge browser panel.

- Version: `1.0.0`
- Audiences: ui
- Effect: `external-write`
- Approval: none
- Scope: global

### Contract

```json
{
  "concurrency": {
    "idempotency": "required",
    "revision": "none"
  },
  "contractVersion": 3,
  "inputSchema": {
    "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
    "additionalProperties": false,
    "properties": {
      "sessionId": {
        "maxLength": 256,
        "minLength": 1,
        "type": "string"
      },
      "surfaceId": {
        "maxLength": 256,
        "minLength": 1,
        "type": "string"
      },
      "url": {
        "default": "http://localhost:5173/",
        "maxLength": 4096,
        "minLength": 1,
        "type": "string"
      }

      "sessionId",
      "surfaceId",
      "url"
    ],
    "type": "object"
  },
  "outputSchema": {

    "additionalProperties": false,
    "properties": {
      "resource": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "properties": {
          "expiresAt": {
            "format": "date-time",
            "pattern": "^(?:(?:\\d\\d[2468][048]|\\d\\d[13579][26]|\\d\\d0[48]|[02468][048]00|[13579][26]00)-02-29|\\d{4}-(?:(?:0[13578]|1[02])-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|3[01])|(?:0[469]|11)-(?:0[1-9]|[12]\\d|30)|(?:02)-(?:0[1-9]|1\\d|2[0-8])))T(?:(?:[01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d(?::[0-5]\\d(?:\\.\\d+)?)?(?:Z|([+-](?:[01]\\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\\d)))$",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "semanticRevision": {
            "maxLength": 256,
            "minLength": 1,
            "type": "string"
          },
          "token": {
            "pattern": "^cap_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}$",
            "type": "string"
          }

          "token",
          "semanticRevision",
          "expiresAt"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "sessionId": {
        "maxLength": 256,
        "minLength": 1,
        "type": "string"
      },
      "surfaceId": {
        "maxLength": 256,
        "minLength": 1,
        "type": "string"
      }
    },
    "required": [
      "resource",
      "sessionId",
      "surfaceId"
    ],
    "type": "object"
  },
  "resourceKinds": [],
  "tags": [
    "browser",
    "playwright",
    "bootstrap"
  ],
  "title": "Open Playwright browser page"
}
```

## `collaboration.sync.retry`

## `content-space.agent-extended-read`

Executes one contracted extended operation against the exact Broker-authorized Content Space resource. Provider-scoped operations require a separate explicit Provider administration grant.

- Version: `2.0.0`
- Audiences: agent
- Effect: `read`
- Approval: none
- Scope: resource

## `content-space.agent-extended-write`

Executes one contracted extended operation against the exact Broker-authorized Content Space resource. Provider-scoped operations require a separate explicit Provider administration grant.

- Version: `2.0.0`
- Audiences: agent
- Effect: `external-write`
- Approval: none
- Scope: resource

## `content-space.agent-list-entries`

Lists direct children beneath one Human-authorized Agent directory scope. Use each returned Broker resource, never its descriptive Provider reference, as authority for child operations.

- Version: `1.0.0`
- Audiences: agent
- Effect: `read`
- Approval: none
- Scope: resource

## `content-space.agent-native-document-destructive`

Executes one provider-native document operation against the exact Broker-authorized Content Space file or container. Selecting the Content Space automatically enables this feature when the Provider supports it.

- Version: `1.0.0`
- Audiences: agent
- Effect: `destructive`
- Approval: confirmation
- Scope: resource

## `content-space.agent-native-document-read`

Executes one provider-native document operation against the exact Broker-authorized Content Space file or container. Selecting the Content Space automatically enables this feature when the Provider supports it.

- Version: `1.0.0`
- Audiences: agent
- Effect: `read`
- Approval: none
- Scope: resource

## `content-space.agent-native-document-workspace-write`

Executes one provider-native document operation against the exact Broker-authorized Content Space file or container. Selecting the Content Space automatically enables this feature when the Provider supports it.

- Version: `1.0.0`
- Audiences: agent
- Effect: `workspace-write`
- Approval: none
- Scope: resource

## `content-space.agent-native-document-write`

Executes one provider-native document operation against the exact Broker-authorized Content Space file or container. Selecting the Content Space automatically enables this feature when the Provider supports it.

- Version: `1.0.0`
- Audiences: agent
- Effect: `external-write`
- Approval: none
- Scope: resource

```json
              "minLength": 1,

            }
          },
          "required": [
```

```json
            "providerId",
            "resourceId",
            "resourceName",
            "operationId",
            "inputTemplate"

          "type": "object"
        },
        "maxItems": 50,

      },
      "sourceIds": {
        "items": {
          "maxLength": 160,
          "minLength": 1,
          "type": "string"
        },
        "maxItems": 50,
        "minItems": 1,
        "type": "array"
      }
    },
    "required": [

      "output",
```

## `evidence-dag.update`

Queues one durable Evidence-only update for a completed agent thread.

- Version: `1.0.0`
- Audiences: ui, agent
- Effect: `compute`
- Approval: none
- Scope: workspace

## `identity.cloud.reauthenticate`

Requires a fresh browser authentication for the current cloud User.

- Version: `1.0.0`
- Audiences: ui
- Effect: `external-write`
- Approval: none
- Scope: global

## `project-coordinator.artifact-review.prepare`

Re-reads the exact current Cloud submission and binding before returning one Host-scoped non-authorizing Content Space review reference.

```json
{

  },

      },

        "pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$",

      },

        "pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$",

      },

        "pattern": "^tsk_[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9_]{10,62}[A-Za-z0-9])$",

    "required": [

  },

    "additionalProperties": false,

        "pattern": "^exe_[A-Za-z0-9](?:[A-Za-z0-9_]{10,62}[A-Za-z0-9])$",
        "type": "string"
      },
      "locatorDigest": {
        "pattern": "^[a-f0-9]{64}$",

        "maximum": 99,
        "minimum": 0,
        "type": "integer"
      },
      "projectId": {

      },

                "type": "string"
```

## `project-coordinator.content-recovery.observe-link`

Re-reads the current recovery tuple, invokes the canonical Content Space exact observation, and links only the Host-derived portable output facts.

- Version: `1.0.0`
- Audiences: ui
- Effect: `external-write`
- Approval: confirmation
- Scope: global

## `project-coordinator.content-recovery.retry-successor`

Re-reads the completed abandon facts and asks only the current Coordinator Agent to issue a new fenced execution with a new no-overwrite filename.

- Version: `1.0.0`
- Audiences: ui
- Effect: `external-write`
- Approval: confirmation
- Scope: global

## `project-coordinator.coordinator.transfer`

Lets the authenticated Project Owner select another exact ready Agent that they own; main derives all Cloud CAS facts and the old Coordinator is fenced atomically.

- Version: `1.0.0`
- Audiences: ui
- Effect: `external-write`
- Approval: confirmation
- Scope: global

```json
  "title": "Transfer Project Coordinator"
}
```

## `project-coordinator.membership.add`

Adds the exact User and Provider fact to Cloud; content-required membership remains pending until a fresh signed Provider observation succeeds.

- Version: `1.0.0`
- Audiences: ui
- Effect: `external-write`
- Approval: confirmation
- Scope: global

## `project-coordinator.membership.remove`

Fences Cloud Task Authority first; content-required membership remains removal-pending until Provider absence is observed and signed.

- Version: `1.0.0`
- Audiences: ui
- Effect: `destructive`
- Approval: confirmation
- Scope: global

## `project-coordinator.plan-draft.read`

Reads the package-owned non-secret draft for one exact Project.

## `project-coordinator.plan.submit`

Submits the immutable digest through the current Coordinator Agent durable Cloud command service.

- Version: `1.0.0`
- Audiences: ui
- Effect: `external-write`
- Approval: confirmation
- Scope: global

### Contract

```json
    "idempotency": "required",
    "revision": "none"
```

## `project-coordinator.project.create`

Creates one Cloud-authoritative Project for the current OIDC Owner and returns exact Desktop focus.

- Version: `1.0.0`
- Audiences: ui
- Effect: `external-write`
- Approval: confirmation
- Scope: global

## `project-coordinator.workspace.read`

Reads the non-secret Project Plan, User-grouped Worker candidates, Tasks, reviews, and content provisioning state.

- Version: `1.0.0`
- Audiences: ui
- Effect: `read`
- Approval: none
- Scope: global

- Audiences: ui, agent, system
- Effect: `compute`

## `project-dag.view`

Reads the canonical committed Project graph and current update state.

- Version: `1.0.0`
- Audiences: ui, agent, system
- Effect: `read`
- Approval: none
- Scope: workspace

## `research-checkpoints.read`

Reads a committed checkpoint by recording or exact Artifact Version.

- Version: `1.0.0`
- Audiences: ui, agent, system
- Effect: `read`
- Approval: none
- Scope: workspace

## `research-checkpoints.resolve`

Explicitly rebases or discards one stale checkpoint while preserving immutable history.

- Version: `1.0.0`
- Audiences: ui
- Effect: `workspace-write`
- Approval: confirmation
- Scope: workspace

Builds a deterministic local job-loop trace without submitting external work.

- Approval: none

## `scientific-plotting.render`

Renders a versioned PNG with exact data, statistics, recipe, environment, manifest, and logs.

- Version: `1.0.0`
- Audiences: ui, agent, system
- Effect: `workspace-write`
- Approval: none
- Scope: workspace

## `scientific-plotting.rerun`

## `visual-review.apply-style-reference`

Extracts a manuscript visual style from one reference image and applies it to the current Visual Review document.

- Version: `1.0.0`
- Audiences: ui
- Effect: `workspace-write`
- Approval: none
- Scope: workspace

## `visual-review.export-review-packet`

## `visual-review.open`

Opens or creates the canonical Visual Review document and optionally stages one source artifact.

- Version: `1.0.0`
- Audiences: ui, agent, system
- Effect: `workspace-write`
- Approval: none
- Scope: workspace

## `visual-review.read-document`

Reads one existing canonical Visual Review document without creating it.

- Version: `1.0.0`
- Audiences: ui, agent, system
- Effect: `read`
- Approval: none
- Scope: workspace

## `workspace-preview.prepare-artifact`

Prepares a bounded derived artifact using the canonical preview provider.

- Version: `1.0.0`
- Audiences: ui, agent, system
- Effect: `compute`
- Approval: none
- Scope: resource

### Contract

```json
{
  "concurrency": {
    "idempotency": "required",
    "revision": "none"
  },
  "contractVersion": 3,
  "inputSchema": {
    "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
    "additionalProperties": false,
    "properties": {
      "request": {
        "oneOf": [
          {
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "properties": {
              "kind": {
                "const": "cache-artifact",
                "type": "string"
              },
              "metadataKind": {
                "maxLength": 128,
                "minLength": 1,
                "type": "string"
              },
              "source": {
                "enum": [
                  "observation",
                  "plugin-metadata"
                ],
                "type": "string"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "kind",
              "source"
            ],
            "type": "object"
          },
          {
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "properties": {
              "channelIndex": {
                "maximum": 1000000,
                "minimum": 0,
                "type": "integer"
              },
              "height": {
                "exclusiveMinimum": 0,
                "maximum": 100000,
                "type": "integer"
              },
              "kind": {
                "const": "tile",
                "type": "string"
              },
              "level": {
                "maximum": 1000000,
                "minimum": 0,
                "type": "integer"
              },
              "t": {
                "maximum": 1000000,
                "minimum": 0,
                "type": "integer"
              },
              "width": {
                "exclusiveMinimum": 0,
                "maximum": 100000,
                "type": "integer"
              },
              "x": {
                "maximum": 1000000,
                "minimum": 0,
                "type": "integer"
              },
              "y": {
                "maximum": 1000000,
                "minimum": 0,
                "type": "integer"
              },
              "z": {
                "maximum": 1000000,
                "minimum": 0,
                "type": "integer"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "kind",
              "level",
              "x",
              "y",
              "width",
              "height"
            ],
            "type": "object"
          },
          {
            "additionalProperties": false,
            "properties": {
              "channelIndex": {
                "maximum": 1000000,
                "minimum": 0,
                "type": "integer"
              },
              "height": {
                "exclusiveMinimum": 0,
                "maximum": 4096,
                "type": "integer"
              },
              "kind": {
                "const": "thumbnail",
                "type": "string"
              },
              "t": {
                "maximum": 1000000,
                "minimum": 0,
                "type": "integer"
              },
              "width": {
                "exclusiveMinimum": 0,
                "maximum": 4096,
                "type": "integer"
              },
              "z": {
                "maximum": 1000000,
                "minimum": 0,
                "type": "integer"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "kind",
              "width",
              "height"
            ],
            "type": "object"
          }
        ]
      }
    },
    "required": [
      "request"
    ],
    "type": "object"
  },
  "outputSchema": {
    "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
    "anyOf": [
      {
        "type": "null"
      },
      {
        "type": "boolean"
      },
      {
        "type": "number"
      },
      {
        "type": "string"
      },
      {
        "items": {

      },
      {
        "additionalProperties": {

        },
        "propertyNames": {
```

```json
      "request": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "properties": {

            "maxLength": 256,

        "items": {

      },
      {
        "additionalProperties": {
          "$ref": "#"
        },
        "propertyNames": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "type": "object"
      }

  "resourceKinds": [
    "workspace-preview"
```
